sections.heading: Ganpat University vs Silver Oak University for Diploma in Design: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a placement winner, because neither university has a diploma-in-design placement row in our records.
On recorded year tuition the sides are close: ₹1.50 lakh for Ganpat University and ₹1.40 lakh for Silver Oak University. Confirm both official circulars before you treat that small gap as decisive.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ganpat University has recorded tuition of ₹1.50 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed programme total, until you check the official notice for the diploma duration.
Silver Oak University has recorded tuition of ₹1.40 lakh a year. The gap is ₹10,000 a year in our records. Confirm any studio, material or examination charges that may sit outside this number.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has a placement row on this page. Do not assume a package that we do not hold.
Ask each university for its latest official design placement or internship report, and compare the same graduating year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Diploma admissions may use Class 10 or Class 12 marks, a portfolio, or an institute test.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility and duration.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Silver Oak University is in Ahmedabad. Ganpat University's main campus is at Kherva, in Mehsana district.
Visit the teaching campus you will join. A region label on this page does not always mean the same daily commute.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded year tuition, Silver Oak University is slightly lower, at ₹1.40 lakh against Ganpat's ₹1.50 lakh.
Because placements are missing, use official studio facilities, duration and the current fee circular to decide.
